title: Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version, now perform well in machine-learning tasks, but they rely on frontier models and hundreds of calls per run. Small open-weight models are far cheaper, yet when used alone, their programs often crash and their improvements stall. We propose DiVE (diverse models evolve), an ensemble method for RSI that aims to improve creativity and diversity of generated solutions. DiVE uses three components: a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds. This allows models to write candidate solutions from the same context and retain the best idea at each iteration. translated_title: 多样性胜过规模：基于小型开源权重模型集成的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步显著提升了智能体在各类任务中的能力。递归自我改进（RSI）循环是指语言模型反复重写程序并在其先前版本的基础上不断改进，如今这类循环在机器学习任务中表现良好，但它们依赖于前沿模型，且每次运行需要数百次调用。小型开源权重模型要便宜得多，但如果单独使用，其生成的程序经常崩溃，改进也会停滞。我们提出了 DiVE（diverse models evolve，多样模型演化），这是一种用于递归自我改进的集成方法，旨在提升生成解决方案的创造性与多样性。DiVE 包含三个组件：共享记忆、失败日志和最优想法胜出轮次。这使得多个模型能够在相同的上下文中编写候选解决方案，并在每次迭代中保留最佳想法。在 22 项 MLE-bench Lite 竞赛中，由五个 8-12B 开源权重模型组成的集成模型的测试误差比其平均成员降低了 25.4%。
tldr: 提出 DiVE 集成方法，通过共享记忆、失败日志和最优想法胜出轮次三个机制，让多个小型开源权重模型协同进行递归自我改进，用模型多样性弥补单模型规模不足，在 MLE-bench Lite 竞赛中测试误差比平均单个成员降低 25.4%。
en_tdlr: DiVE is an ensemble method for recursive self-improvement that combines diverse small open-weight models through a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds, reducing test error by 25.4% over average individual models on MLE-bench Lite competitions.
